text: {"label":"Quantitative Models of Choice Behavior","definition":"Basic and theoretical research on choice, including matching and concurrent-schedule models, changeover behavior, suboptimal and intertemporal choice, behavior dynamics theories, and choice under reinforcing and punishing contingencies.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on general choice theory and quantitative modeling, not conditioned reinforcement and delay effects on human choice, stimulus preference assessments, or behavioral economic demand analyses."}
